text:
Maria S.: Heads up — board-level ask from Meridian Insurance: they want a final cost model + KMS egress attestation for the POC by EOD Thurs. CISO wants a brief bridge with their CTO.
Kevin L.: Ok — can we get a clear SSO/KMS diagram + egress paperwork? I can draft pricing once I have usage.
Anjali R.: Need to know if they require BYO-KMS (HSM) or are okay with Redwood-managed keys. Also any specific egress retention windows?
Maria S.: They prefer BYO-KMS (HSM) and strict egress logging. Also asked about per-token cap, canary fallback, and data residency assurances.
Luis G.: From infra side: BYO-KMS in a Private deployment/VPC is doable but requires network peering + route table setup. Rough ETA: 3 business days for full config and tests.
Kevin L.: They also want a demo showing KMS rotation and audit log export. Can eng prep a short recording? @Luis
Luis G.: Yep — I can record a 6–8 min walkthrough tomorrow. Will need a sample key policy from their side to demo exact flows.
Anjali R.: I'll draft attestation language and include PCI/ISO snippets we typically hand to large insurers. Send any legal clause flags.
Maria S.: Sales exec requests an exec bridge with Meridian CTO + our VP Sales on Fri 10:00am PT. Can we commit to KMS demo + cost slide before then?
Kevin L.: I can do the cost slide if I get their token/day estimate and expected concurrency. Maria, can you share the profile?
Maria S.: They projected ~20M tokens/day during pilot bursts; steady 2-3M/day. I've emailed the full traffic spreadsheet to the thread privately.
DeployBot: deploy:build pipeline triggered by @Luis G. — release-handoff job started :rocket:
Luis G.: Recording done and uploaded to drive (link shared in DM). I also put network diagram + minimal infra steps in that folder.
Anjali R.: Draft attestation (v0): "Redwood supports customer-managed keys via KMS integration; audit logs can be exported to customer's S3; key rotations supported; egress logging retained for 90 days." Thoughts?
Maria S.: Looks good as a start. Legal will need to review. @Kevin add a line for compliance teams: "no model weights or training data are shared with third parties."
Kevin L.: :thumbsup: Will add that line and finalize cost slide. Who will own the invite?
Maria S.: I'll send the bridge invite once I confirm Meridian availability. Need eng/security confirmation that demo + attestation doc are ready by Fri 9:00am PT.
Luis G.: Confirming demo + recording + short runbook ready by 8:30am PT Fri. Will include network peering checklist and minimal ACL steps.
Anjali R.: I'll hand the final attestation doc to legal by Thu EOD for a quick review.
Maria S.: Great — thanks team. I'll update our exec and share the bridge link once legal ACKs.
